facts.fact: 车停在铁门旁的小屋前，门上绑着牌子要求完全停车，车门随即自动解锁
facts.anchor: PLEASE COME TO A FULL STOP.

facts.fact: Abi 说门卫要查证件，确认来者就是自称的那个人
facts.anchor: To make sure you are who you say you are.

facts.fact: 门卫 Ernesto 极年轻，留着大胡子像是为了显老
facts.anchor: He was extremely young, and I suspected his full beard

facts.fact: Abi 说她更喜欢夜班门卫，那人是 Ernesto 的双胞胎兄弟
facts.anchor: believe it or not, happens to be Ernesto

facts.fact: Abi 交代 Ernesto 上白班，从下午两点到晚上十点
facts.anchor: He works from two in the afternoon till ten at night

facts.fact: Abi 说庄园内外都不装摄像头，安全全靠这片围栏
facts.anchor: You know there are no cameras? Inside or out.

facts.fact: 叙述者行使作者特权，把夜景临时搬到午后
facts.anchor: transport us from nighttime to mid-afternoon

facts.fact: 塔楼底部的白射灯把房子照出不祥气，像小孩讲鬼故事
facts.anchor: the way children shine flashlights under their chins

facts.fact: 她发现 Abi 对自己的长相远没有她那么上心
facts.anchor: Because she actually liked who she was.
